claims: Reassess and manage hypotension (recent systolic BP 89-99 mmHg, MAP 62-67 mmHg) with appropriate fluid resuscitation and hemodynamic monitoring.
Continue and reassess broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy (levofloxacin, metronidazole, oral vancomycin) given leukocytosis (WBC 22.4-27.9 K/uL).
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status; patient requires supplemental O2 at 4 L/min with SpO2 98-99%.
Repeat basic metabolic panel to reassess hyponatremia (Na 128-133 mEq/L), hypocalcemia (total Ca 7.0-7.8 mg/dL), and metabolic acidosis (bicarbonate 18-20 mEq/L, anion gap 15-17).
Trend lactate (1.5-2.4 mmol/L) to assess for ongoing hypoperfusion.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (Hgb 9.3-10.2 g/dL, Hct 28.7-32.3%) and assess for bleeding or need for transfusion.
Replete and monitor magnesium and phosphorus (magnesium 2.7 mg/dL, phosphate 2.2-3.8 mg/dL) as indicated.
Monitor blood glucose (fingerstick 113 mg/dL, serum 148 mg/dL) and continue glycemic control.
Implement fall precautions given high fall risk (history of falls, bed rest, IV access, altered mental status).
Perform aspiration precautions and oral care given mildly impaired swallow and increased secretions (OCAT findings).
